name: pi-session-blackboard
description: Session-level blackboard for pi coding agent: deterministic per-turn extraction, agent-curated commits, deterministic archival. Zero background LLM calls.

scripts.build: node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc src/extract.ts src/board.ts src/types.ts src/paths.ts src/state.ts src/compact-assist.ts src/summary.ts src/recall.ts src/config.ts --outDir build --module NodeNext --target ES2022 --moduleResolution NodeNext --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --strict
